text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, while everyone in the dorm is asleep…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Common ☆ spiderwort! Mirror, mirror, answer my call.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: My magic's really improving! My times are getting better, and I learned a whole bunch of new incantations too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Ugh! You stupid mirror! Just say something already!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grrr! Are you trying to tell me my magic still isn't good enough?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fine! Mirror, mirror, you just watch! I'm not stepping an inch off my path to become a grand witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be a grand witch like Grandma, and then I'll show you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Listen up! Starting today, we're gonna do the training I wanna do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And that means a bunch of training to build up the magical energy I need right now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And I'm not gonna be doing any other training at all! Got that, Familiar?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having my own training plans thrown out the window is tough… but I don't want her enthusiasm to go to waste. I'll let her be the boss for the time being!
